free_tier.stated: 10 GB file storage + 250 MB DB per PocketBase slot — slots are $9.99/mo (or $5/mo annual, or lifetime), with a 7-day trial

retention.stated: 10 GB file storage + 250 MB DB per PocketBase slot — slots are $9.99/mo (or $5/mo annual, or lifetime), with a 7-day trial

egress.terms: Unmetered bandwidth and CPU, fair use — this is the standout: storage is paid but egress is genuinely unmetered.

tooling: PocketBase REST/realtime API, `pocketbase` JS/Dart SDKs, SFTP file access on PocketHost, S3 storage backend supported (like standalone PocketBase)
chaining: Storage pools across slots ('Storage adds to your account pool, shared across every PocketBase you run'), so 10 slots = 100 GB for ~$50-100/mo. Not free, but the only entrant here with unmetered egress. Self-hosting PocketBase is free/MIT — that is the free path, on compute he already has.

limits.value: bandwidth could be throttled at sustained high volume

limits_note: 7-day risk-free trial only; 10 GB per slot; SFTP access is a real plus for bulk transfer; fair-use bandwidth could be throttled at sustained high volume.
reliability_note: Run by a single maintainer (benallfree) on DigitalOcean; data volume not encrypted at OS level per their own FAQ. Small-operator risk.

evidence.proved: 'Each slot includes 250 MB DB data storage and 10 GB file storage ... Unmetered bandwidth and CPU (fair use)', '$9.99 per PocketBase, per month', '7 day riskfree trial'
'While the data volume is not encrypted at the OS level ... you can always back up and download your data via SFTP'
